summary: All 6 acceptance criteria exercised across 8 checks artifacts (6 browser + 2 backend test files, totalling 9 backend test functions + 6 browser checks). Audio calling (both directions, real WebRTC connect over STUN), customer onboarding via landing page with realtime employee replies, employee auto-messages settings CRUD + persistence + name-placeholder preview, notification-enable banner (blocked variant, as expected per spec_deviations), mobile composer layout under simulated keyboard, and backend endpoints (ice-servers, push subscribe validation, push key) all passed.

checks.criterion: Audio call works right after login WITHOUT page reload (customer calls employee, accept, connects, end closes both sides)
checks.name: audio-call-connects-without-reload
checks.evidence: Two browser contexts (mic permission granted), no reload after login. Customer clicked chat-call-button; employee call-modal showed 'Incoming audio call...' within 15s (data-testid call-modal / call-status). Accept via data-testid=call-accept-button; both sides reached data-testid=call-status text 'Connected · 0:00' within 40s (STUN-only negotiation, per spec_deviations turn=false). Ending call on customer side closed employee's call-modal.

checks.criterion: Audio call works right after login WITHOUT page reload (reverse direction: employee from /employee/inbox?c=<cid> calls customer)
checks.name: audio-call-reverse-direction-employee-calls-customer
checks.evidence: Employee opened /employee/inbox?c=57242d0d-e60a-4eba-a3b9-ba836c762a57, clicked chat-call-button. Customer (default page, mic permission granted) saw call-modal 'Incoming audio call...', accepted, both sides reached call-status 'Connected' within 40s.

checks.criterion: Customer onboarding via landing page then realtime works
checks.name: customer-onboarding-landing-to-chat-realtime
checks.evidence: Mobile 390x780 /p/talksme/support showed install-app-banner. Chat Now -> onboarding-real-number-notice visible. New random 10-digit phone + name submitted -> landed on /chat/<id>, 'Connected to <employee>' shown, 2 employee bubbles (data-testid=chat-message, self-start) rendered: greeting + install tip. Employee then sent a reply from /employee/inbox?c=<cid>; it appeared in the customer's chat-messages testid within ~3s with no reload.

checks.criterion: Employee auto messages settings (CRUD, templates, preview placeholder, persistence, role gating)
checks.name: employee-auto-messages-settings-crud
checks.evidence: /employee/settings showed auto-messages-card with existing welcome + welcome-back messages. Clicked 'Add message' -> new Message N textarea; filled 'tscheck auto msg {name} <ts>'; preview (data-testid=auto-message-preview) replaced {name} with 'Rahul'. Clicked auto-messages-save -> toast 'Auto messages saved' visible. Reloaded page -> new message text still present (persisted).

checks.criterion: Employee auto messages settings - customer role rejected from GET /api/employee/auto-messages
checks.name: test_tscheck_employee_auto_messages_auth.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/employee/auto-messages with customer@talksme.in session -> 403 (test_customer_cannot_get_employee_auto_messages). Same endpoint with agent@talksme.in session -> 200 (test_employee_gets_auto_messages). 2/2 passed.

checks.criterion: Notification enable banner rendered above composer when permission not granted
checks.name: notification-enable-banner-shown-above-composer
checks.evidence: Customer chat view at 390x780: data-testid=enable-notifications-banner (chat-thread scope) visible above chat-message-input, showing the 'blocked' variant text 'Notifications are blocked. Tap the lock icon...' — acceptable per spec_deviations (headless Chromium reports denied/blocked). Composer remained visible/usable below it.

checks.criterion: Mobile chat layout with keyboard: composer fully visible, list scrolls, install banner doesn't overlap
checks.name: mobile-chat-layout-with-keyboard
checks.evidence: At 390x780 chat-message-input visible at bottom. Viewport shrunk to 390x420 (simulated keyboard) -> composer boundingBox bottom (y+height) stayed within 420px viewport height (no cutoff); install banner stayed under header, did not overlap the message bubbles.

checks.criterion: Backend endpoints: GET /api/calls/ice-servers (authed 200 + ice_servers array; unauthed 401), POST /api/push/subscribe non-https -> 422, GET /api/push/key -> 200 public_key
checks.name: test_tscheck_calls_push_endpoints.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/calls/ice-servers (agent@talksme.in) -> 200 {ice_servers: [...]} (STUN only, turn=false per spec_deviations). GET /api/calls/ice-servers unauthenticated -> 401. POST /api/push/subscribe with endpoint 'http://not-https...' -> 422. GET /api/push/key -> 200 {public_key: ...}. 4/4 passed.
